name: Comfrt
description: DTC loungewear brand founded in 2022 around a weighted, oversized hoodie with a mental-health mission, now selling hoodies, sweatpants, blankets, athleisure and matching dog hoodies. Its growth is creator-led: an open Ambassador Program pays commission on sales driven through personal links, and the brand is reported to be TikTok Shop's top lifestyle and apparel brand.

evidence.summary: Comfrt's own Ambassador Program Terms & Conditions (fetched in full) state that accepted ambassadors earn ten percent (10%) of the Gross Revenue (amount paid for merchandise, excluding shipping and tax) on purchases made through their unique Ambassador Link, and give ambassador@comfrt.com as the program contact. The terms state NO earnings cap, so the cap is recorded as unknown, not uncapped - a third-party coupon page's 'no cap on earnings' claim does not count under the strict filter.

Collabz case study (fetched) reports Comfrt's ambassador program counted more than 250,000 ambassadors and a TikTok affiliate community of about 600,000, with 9,393 creators posting 50,000+ TikTok Shop videos in one 30-day stretch of 2026 - absolute big-number evidence, so creator saturation is recorded as high. It also corroborates the standard 10% ambassador commission and $500M+ in sales within three years.

reasons.niche_fit: Pure loungewear/apparel brand built for social-first fashion creators - squarely in the fashion UGC niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Creator-led by design: 250,000+ ambassadors and ~600,000 TikTok affiliates reported, with tens of thousands of creator videos per month.
reasons.compensation: 10% of gross merchandise revenue per its own published terms; no cap stated anywhere in the terms, so cap is unknown, not uncapped.
reasons.contact_access: Published program email (ambassador@comfrt.com) in the brand's own terms plus an open application route.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is open to customers as well as creators, applications reviewed on a rolling basis.
reasons.credibility: Reported $500M+ sales in three years and TikTok Shop's top apparel brand, per a third-party case study - strong but not audited.

name: Intrepid Travel
description: Small-group adventure tour operator founded in 1989 and now one of the world's largest travel B Corporations, running 1,000+ itineraries across all seven continents with local leaders and a responsible-travel mission. Its affiliate program explicitly recruits individual creators and travel advocates as well as organizations.

evidence.summary: Intrepid's own affiliate sign-up page (fetched in full) describes commission on every successful booking, a dedicated affiliate management team and real-time tracking, with separate application paths for organizations and for individual creators/travel advocates; both 'Apply now' buttons route to app.impact.com, identifying Impact as the network. The page publishes no rate, cap or creator count.

Lasso's Intrepid Travel listing (fetched in full) states a 4% commission per sale and a 60-day cookie duration. No fetched source states an earnings cap or publishes creator counts, so both are recorded as unknown. (Travel-agent channel commissions of 15-17% reported elsewhere are trade rates, not the creator affiliate program, and are excluded.)

reasons.niche_fit: Adventure group tours are a core travel-creator category; the brand recruits creators and travel advocates by name.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Own affiliate page speaks directly to content creators and storytellers and offers content-experience partnerships, but publishes no creator counts.
reasons.compensation: 4% per sale (Lasso listing) on high-value tour bookings with a long 60-day cookie; no cap statement, so cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Own affiliate page with a dedicated affiliate team; application via Impact; no public email published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is live with open applications for both organizations and individual creators.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 1989, certified B Corporation, 1,000+ itineraries worldwide.

name: Hostelworld
description: Global hostel-booking platform listing 36,000+ properties in around 180 countries, aimed at backpackers and budget travellers. Its affiliate programme is free to join, runs on Partnerize, and pays CPA commission calculated as a percentage of the deposit Hostelworld earns on each completed booking.

evidence.summary: Hostelworld's own affiliate FAQ (fetched in full) states the programme is free to join, commission is CPA calculated as a percentage of the deposit earned by Hostelworld per booking (earned once the booking is completed), tracking uses a 30-day cookie with last-click attribution, sign-up is via Partnerize, and the affiliate team email is affiliates@hostelworld.com. The FAQ publishes no percentage figure, cap or creator count.

Third-party figures for the percentage conflict - commonly cited as 40% of the booking deposit, while other directories cite 18-22% of Hostelworld's booking commission - so commission_rate is recorded as null with the basis documented: a percentage of the deposit Hostelworld earns per completed booking. No source states an earnings cap.

reasons.niche_fit: The default hostel-booking platform for backpacker and budget-travel creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Open affiliate programme pitched at travel sites and creators, but no dedicated creator program page or published creator counts.
reasons.compensation: Percentage-of-deposit CPA confirmed on the brand's own FAQ, but the percentage itself is unpublished there and third-party figures conflict (40% of deposit vs 18-22% of booking commission), so the rate is null; no cap stated.
reasons.contact_access: Published affiliate team email (affiliates@hostelworld.com) on the brand's own partner site, plus Partnerize application.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join via Partnerize, application reviewed by Hostelworld.
reasons.credibility: Long-established global OTA focused on hostels, 36,000+ properties.

name: TrustedHousesitters
description: Membership platform matching pet owners with vetted house and pet sitters in 130+ countries, so members travel while pets stay at home. Its affiliate program targets experienced content creators and publishers (5,000+ followers or monthly views) and runs through Awin/CJ.

evidence.summary: TrustedHousesitters' own support article (fetched in full) confirms the affiliate program for content creators and publishers and gives partnerships@trustedhousesitters.com for affiliate and partnership applications. A companion support article states affiliates need 5,000+ followers on one channel and/or 5,000 monthly blog views.

Rate figures conflict across fetched sources: Lasso lists 20% per sale with a 30-day cookie, its US listing shows a $28 flat per sale, other sources cite up to 40% per membership and a $100 flat homeowner bounty - so commission_rate is recorded as null with the conflict documented. Listings place the program on Awin (some also cite CJ). No source states an earnings cap or absolute creator counts.

reasons.niche_fit: House/pet sitting is a distinctive, content-rich travel niche (slow travel, pet care, digital-nomad life).
reasons.ugc_evidence: Affiliate program explicitly aimed at content creators, plus a separate smaller-creator Tailblazers scheme; no creator counts published.
reasons.compensation: Published figures conflict (20% per sale vs $28 flat US vs up to 40% vs $100 flat homeowner bounty), so the rate is null; no cap stated.
reasons.contact_access: Published partnerships email for affiliate applications on the brand's own support site, plus network application.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to creators meeting a 5,000-follower / 5,000-monthly-view threshold - a real but modest gate.
reasons.credibility: Established membership platform operating in 130+ countries.

name: 12Go
description: Online travel agency founded in 2013 for booking trains, buses, ferries, flights and transfers across 100+ countries, strongest in Southeast Asia and Oceania. Its affiliate program pays partners 50% of 12Go's profit per booking and is also distributed through Travelpayouts.

evidence.summary: 12Go's own affiliate program page (fetched in full) states: 'We give our partners 50% of the total profit. The average commission is $3 per booking.' It also confirms a 30-day last-click cookie, payouts via PayPal/Wise/bank transfer, no website required (social media communities qualify), free joining, and the contact affiliate@12go.asia. The page states no earnings cap and no creator count.

Travelpayouts' program roundup corroborates 12Go's 50% revenue share on on-site sales across 100+ countries and notes the same ~$3 average per booking; other Travelpayouts pages express the effective rate as roughly 4-5.5% of booking value. The 50% figure is a share of 12Go's profit, not of the booking price.

reasons.niche_fit: Multi-modal ground and ferry transport booking is core backpacker and Asia-travel creator content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program explicitly open to travel sites, blogs and social media communities; no creator counts published.
reasons.compensation: 50% of 12Go's profit per booking per its own page (revenue share basis; ~$3 average per booking, roughly 4-5.5% of booking value). No cap statement, so cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Published affiliate email (affiliate@12go.asia) and support contact on the brand's own agent portal.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join, no website required, applications via the agent portal or Travelpayouts.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2013, 3M+ travellers and 180,000+ positive reviews reported by its network listing.

name: MVMT
description: Los Angeles-founded accessories brand launched in 2013 selling minimalist watches, eyewear and jewelry direct to consumers at accessible prices. Its affiliate program runs through FlexOffers.

evidence.summary: Lasso's MVMT Watches listing (fetched in full) states an 8% commission per sale and a 30-day cookie, categorized under Fashion/Watch/Jewelry; its join button routes to publisherpro.flexoffers.com, identifying FlexOffers as the network. A Shopper listing's vaguer 5-10% range brackets the same figure. No earnings cap or creator count is published, so both are recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Watches, eyewear and jewelry are staple fashion-accessory creator categories.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Public affiliate program on a major network; brand was built on social/influencer marketing, but no creator program page or counts found.
reasons.compensation: 8% per sale (Lasso listing); no cap statement published, so cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the FlexOffers network listing; no public creator contact email published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is live and joinable through FlexOffers signup.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC accessories brand founded in 2013, widely distributed.

name: Omio
description: Berlin-founded travel platform (formerly GoEuro) for comparing and booking trains, buses, flights and ferries from 1,000+ carriers, strongest across Europe. Its affiliate program runs through Travelpayouts (also listed on Impact) and pays on booking value.

evidence.summary: Travelpayouts' own Omio program page (fetched in full) headlines a 6% reward on booking value with a 30-day last-click cookie, but its dual-payout detail describes a EUR0.26 lead payment plus a 3.4% booking conversion - an internal conflict. Omio's own affiliate page confirms the programme exists but publishes no rate, referring applicants to its partner team.

Lasso lists Omio at a 2-8% per-sale range with a 30-day cookie, consistent with a market-dependent structure rather than one flat rate. Because the fetched figures conflict (6% headline vs 3.4% booking conversion vs 2-8% range), commission_rate is recorded as null. No source states an earnings cap or creator counts.

reasons.niche_fit: Multi-modal European trip planning is core travel-creator content; Omio explicitly accepts social and content partners.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Long-running affiliate program open to content sites and social channels; no dedicated creator program or published counts.
reasons.compensation: Figures conflict across fetched sources (6% headline vs 3.4% booking conversion plus lead fee vs 2-8% range), so the rate is null; no cap stated.
reasons.contact_access: Application through Travelpayouts and Omio's own affiliate page; no public email recovered from fetched pages.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is live on Travelpayouts with open publisher signup.
reasons.credibility: Major European travel platform founded in 2013, 25M+ monthly visits reported by its network page.

name: Sunski

evidence.summary: A fetched sunglasses-program roundup states Sunski pays 8% commission with a 30-day cookie and average order value above $65, and that the program is administered through AvantLink, with banners, product feeds and custom promotions available. reasons.niche_fit: Polarized sunglasses are a proven outdoor-fashion accessory category for creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Network affiliate program with promotional incentives; no creator program page or published counts found.
reasons.compensation: 8% per sale per a single secondary listing (flagged needs_review); no cap statement, so cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through AvantLink; no public creator contact email published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program listed as live on AvantLink, subject to network approval.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC eyewear brand and 1% for the Planet member.

reasons.compensation: 10% per sale per a single secondary listing (flagged needs_review), with a high reported average order value; no cap statement, so cap is unknown.

name: Pura Vida Bracelets
description: Jewelry brand built on artisan-made bracelets, now selling bracelets, rings, necklaces and apparel while funding artisan jobs and charity partners. Its long-running affiliate program is administered through ShareASale (payments processed by ShareASale per its own terms).

evidence.summary: Pura Vida's own Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions (fetched in full) confirm a live affiliate program: applications reviewed within 48 hours, sales lock 30 days after transaction, and 'All payments will be processed by ShareASale', with program coupon codes distributed through the ShareASale Deals Database - identifying ShareASale as the network. The terms publish no headline commission percentage and no earnings cap.

Rate figures conflict: a program review cites up to 12% per the ShareASale profile (an 'up to' ceiling, not a flat rate), while a Shopper partnership listing shows 0.7% - so commission_rate is recorded as null with the conflict documented. Note the brand's published terms are dated 2016 and exclude affiliates in several US states for tax-nexus reasons.

reasons.niche_fit: Artisan bracelets and beachy jewelry are a staple affordable-fashion creator category.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Long-running public affiliate program; brand grew through social and campus reps, but no current creator counts published.
reasons.compensation: Rate is null: the only figures found conflict (up to 12% ceiling vs 0.7% listing) and the brand's own terms publish no percentage; no cap stated.
reasons.contact_access: Application via ShareASale under the brand's published terms; no public creator contact email published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program terms are live on the brand's site, though dated 2016 and excluding affiliates in a list of US states.
reasons.credibility: Established national brand with retail distribution and a documented charity/artisan model.
